description: This file defines a wizard for converting CRM cases into sale orders in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form layout, data fields, and order creation logic.

classes.name: make_sale
classes.description: Wizard interface class for converting CRM cases to sale orders, including methods for selecting partners and creating orders.
